policy.vote_rule: Only a verified ATS side at a known reference line counts as a vote. Missing, paywalled, 50/50, total-only, moneyline-only, or unverified records do not count.
policy.model_rule: Our Model counts as a directional ATS vote only when the frozen model layer has a robust_side. MARKET_EQUAL and SOURCE_DISPUTED_DIRECTION are displayed as NO ROBUST TAKE rather than forced votes.
policy.context_rule: Injuries, quarterback status, weather and roster news are contradiction/alignment diagnostics only. They are not a fifth ATS vote and they do not modify frozen V2 probabilities in this step.
policy.consensus_rule: Do not label 2/4, 3/4 or 4/4 consensus unless that many verified ATS sources are actually available. With inaccessible source picks, use INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE.
policy.external_weights: SportsLine, Gridiron and Lucas retain zero prediction weight.
